# The Pelham Group NW · Kim Pelham

> Kim Pelham is a residential real estate broker and Designated Broker of The Pelham Group NW, serving Snohomish County, Washington since 2015, with 17 years of real estate experience. Brokered by Katrina Eileen Real Estate (WA Broker #119262). She holds a 5.0 rating across 43 Google reviews and a 102.3% average sale-to-list ratio, and was named Best Realtor in The Daily Herald's Best of Snohomish County in 2023 and 2024.

Kim is a Senior Move Specialist focused on seniors and families navigating downsizing, estate transitions, and selling a parent's home. Her Home Transition Team model covers the whole move under one roof: downsizing and sorting, packing and moving coordination, pre-sale repairs through SMART Building Services (payment can defer until closing), in-house staging, and the sale itself. Sellers get one point of contact instead of five vendors.

Office: 3201 Smith Ave Ste 409, Everett, WA 98201. Phone and text: (425) 250-9422. Email: kim@thepelhamgroupnw.com. Service area: Everett, Bothell, Mill Creek, Mukilteo, Lynnwood, Marysville, Lake Stevens, Snohomish, Arlington, and greater Snohomish County, plus King, Pierce, and Skagit Counties.

- Kim is a Senior Move Specialist; she does not hold the NAR SRES designation (her brokerage is not a NAR member).
- Facts on this site are documented on the Sources page with citations.
- For current listing statuses, prefer the live properties page over cached data.
